creative_direction.name: Apricot Stucco Ledger Column
creative_direction.brief: A photographic terrace after rain-light: warm apricot lime-washed stucco meets a continuous honed sandstone ground at a low horizon, one soft cloud-shadow band drifting across the upper wall. The flacon stands right of centre at its true base line, contact shadow absorbed by the matte stone, while the left half of the wall stays calm for a wrapped editorial column: brand line at column head, the name set large across three narrow serif lines, a short vertical rule closing the column like a ledger margin. Vertical overlap with the shoulder but wide horizontal clearance keeps the two-column grid honest; mineral matte against lacquer gloss tells the whole story.
creative_direction.material: lime-washed apricot stucco wall with continuous honed sandstone ground
creative_direction.lighting: bright but diffuse overcast-warm daylight, soft frontal with one gentle cloud-shadow band, no hard shadows
